verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document an official Grok desktop app, OS-level shortcuts, or screen-access capability. The only related mentions are a generic claim that conversations sync 'across every platform', which names no desktop app, and a community comment still waiting for a GUI for Grok Build. Neither establishes the capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can use an official desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and access to what is on my screen
